remarks: A spacious and bright home set on a quiet side street with a private, level half acre in the much sought after Cranberry neighborhood. This updated home includes a formal living room with a wood burning fireplace, a dining room with a walk-out to a large deck, perfect for cookouts and summer entertaining. Enjoy the views of your property with plenty of space for fun and games. Your new home also includes an updated white eat-in-kitchen with stainless steel appliances and stone counters. There are two hall bedrooms, a full bath and a primary bedroom with a full bath and great closet spaces. The lower level has a wonderful family room with a walk-out to your yard, a half bath and a terrific space (heat provided by vent into boiler rm) for a private office/guest bedroom or a music room. A few of the many exceptional features with your home includes beautiful hardwood floors, central air, home generator, two car garage...
